pages.title: Woom Go 4 - Donnybrook Bikes
pages.description: Bike 20″ • 7,7 kg Child 6 – 8 years • 115 – 130 cm   The woom 4 introduces children aged six years to the world of gear-shifting. The bike's eight speeds in combination with the easy-to-operate twist shifter expand the bike's range of use and increase the child's mobility. Whether they want to ride their bikes into the woods or up hills – the new-found freedom of gears make longer adventures on two wheels child's play.
